SELECT 
                                object_id,
                                s_info_windcode,
                                trade_dt,
                                b_info_outstandingbalance,
                                b_info_day,
                                b_info_termnote1,
                                b_info_weightedrt,
                                b_info_weightedrt2,
                                b_anal_precupn,
                                b_anal_nxcupn,
                                b_anal_dailycf,
                                b_dailycf_int,
                                b_dailycf_prin,
                                b_calc_accrint,
                                opdate,
                                opmode,
                                'WIND' as srcsys,
                                cast(current_timestamp as string) as updatetime,
                                cast(current_timestamp as string) as inserttime,
                                cast(replace(substr(cast(current_timestamp as string),1,8),'-','') as decimal(8,0))  as batchno
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_cbondriskreturnindicator WHERE p_dt between ${beg_date} and ${end_date}
